# Required check manifest for the vizra META repo (ADR-002 § CI fan-in and
# merge queue; docs/META_REPO.md §7).
#
# `ci-required` reads this file and fails unless every listed job concluded
# `success` on the head SHA. Anything else — failure, cancellation, timeout,
# skip, never-ran — fails the aggregate, so a lane that silently stops running
# blocks the merge instead of disappearing.
#
# One job name per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# This file is owner-reviewed (CODEOWNERS): it must not be edited in the same
# PR as the thing it guards.
#
# A PR may ADD a lane here. It may not REMOVE the floor lane — `validate` —
# because this manifest is read from the checkout under test, so a PR could
# otherwise stop gating itself by deleting a line. The floor lives in
# scripts/ci-required-guard.sh, not here.
# Entries must be bare job names: no trailing comment, no "optional" marker.
#
# docs/META_REPO.md §7 names three target lanes for this repo — `validate`,
# `bundle` and `boot`. Only `validate` exists today: there is no compose file,
# no installer, no bundle and no image to boot, so `bundle` and `boot` have
# nothing to run against. They are NOT listed here, because listing a lane that
# does not exist would make `ci-required` wait forever for a check nobody
# defined. They are added when the slices that create them land.

validate
